name: Louis Rosier
features: balding, high domed forehead, heavy jowls, thick dark eyebrows, sturdy build, serious unsmiling face
bio: Garage owner from Clermont-Ferrand and the archetypal Talbot-Lago privateer. Won Le Mans in 1950 driving all but two of the twenty-four hours himself, handing over to his son only to refuel. Fourth in the 1950 World Championship on reliability and stamina while the Alfas stopped twice a race for fuel. Died of injuries from Montlhery in 1956.
